messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: infer-edge-usw cluster - 3 nodes NotReady, 2 kubelet restarts detected, pod evictions increasing
maria: seeing spike in 5xx and queueing on infer-edge-usw. console shows 30% of infer pool capacity degraded. paging SREs.
sam: on it, joining. pulling k8s events now
leah: taking customer comms standby. which customers are impacted?
maria: looks like higher P95 latency for text-generation routes, some small customers hit rate limits. will post a list in a sec
pagerduty-bot: @sam acknowledged the pager (INC-9421)
sam: quick check - kubelet logs on node infer-usw-12 show: 
```
Nov 17 12:03:01 kubelet[1234]: E0900 kubelet: runtime: failed to start container: container run hook failed: error running hook: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: container_linux.go:348: starting container process caused "process_linux.go:495: container init caused \"process_linux.go:459: getting the final child's pid failed: \"\""
```
leah: any GPU errors?
maria: yes one node reports GPU driver recoveries in dmesg: `NVRM: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus` followed by `oom_kill` on the runtime. suspect streaming batch jobs + minor memory leak -> OOM on GPU driver side.
sam: I'm cordoning infer-usw-12 and infer-usw-15, draining with --ignore-daemonsets. will move workloads to other pools.
ops: suggest scaling up dedicated capacity in us-east temporarily to absorb traffic.
maria: running drain now:
```
kubectl cordon infer-usw-12
kubectl drain infer-usw-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```
sam: drain completed for infer-usw-12, pods rescheduled to infer-usw-21 and infer-useast-04 per routing policy
incident-bot: Observability: synthetic-checks failing for /v1/generate in us-west for 12m
leah: customer list: small batch of PLG customers in us-west. I'll draft a short status: "We're mitigating a node instability issue in our us-west inference pool causing increased latency; traffic is being routed to healthy capacity. No model data was exposed."
sam: found a crashloop on runtime container on infer-usw-15 with repeated `OOMKilled` and `cuda: device-side assert` in logs. keeping it cordoned.
maria: adding automatic fallback to smaller-quantized model for traffic from affected routes to reduce GPU memory demands. toggling rollout flag.
ops: routing change applied, 80% traffic now to useast and eu-west redundancies.
leah: status update posted to customers, adding note to inc. no PII impact.
sam: creating a short-term kubelet patch for crash recovery - bumping kubelet grace/retry window and disabling aggressive eviction for GPU driver recoveries. will push canary to infer-usw-21
maria: monitoring KV cache hit rates and latency; P95 trending down after drain and routing change.
incident-bot: ACTIONS: cordon+drain x2, traffic steer to other regions, enable quantized fallback model, canary kubelet config to 1 node
leah: planning a postmortem if nodes stay unstable > 6h. capturing logs and heap profiles from runtimes.
sam: ETA for kubelet canary deploy 12m. if stable, roll to rest of pool.
ops: opened infra task INFRA-628 to investigate kernel/driver versions across infer-usw fleet.
maria: good work. anyone still on-call after this? @sam you'll stay until stabilised.
sam: yup staying on until P95 back to normal for 30m.
leah: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and ATO notes.
incident-bot: RESOLVE CHECK: synthetic-checks back to normal after 18m. marking incident as degraded->recovering.
maria: closing the active pager for now, leaving the thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
